text:
Mackie Samoskevich won a Stanley Cup with Florida in 2025 and has opened his first Seattle season with six goals and 12 points in 17 games, playing 15:32 a night.

The finishing is the obvious caution. Six goals on 3.1 expected is a 21% shooting rate, after 7% last season, and the Kraken have scored 4.2 more goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice. His recent chances (1.8 expected goals in ten games) have actually come in below what we'd expect from him, and Seattle has lost its last three.

There's a real player underneath. Evolving-Hockey had him in the 90th percentile among forwards for driving chances last season, with three goals' worth of value just from drawing penalties, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 70% of his zone exits leaving with possession and more than half his shots coming off the rush. The goals will slow down. The job of making Seattle better in transition is the part to watch.
headline: Samoskevich's hot start in Seattle
